incidents.title: Taxonomy Terminology Drift in C1 Report Narrative Table
incidents.scope: Narrative-layer only; data layer (manifest_v3) is unaffected

drift_details.additional_note: C1 used (OF) abbreviation to mean Organic Film (a non-canonical concept close to BS, Biological Slicks); canonical OF = Ocean Front (source_label_id=6)

incidents.data_layer_verification: manifest_v3 class_composition checked across all 147 samples: 0 canonical abbreviation violations, 0 class_name mismatches, 0 source_label_id mismatches. Data is correct.
incidents.resolution: C2 report uses strictly canonical class names from ops01_taxonomy_v1.json. C1 report remains unchanged but its table rows 5, 8, 9, 10 are formally superseded.
incidents.regression_test_description: Add test to verify narrative audit reports reference canonical class names by checking against taxonomy_v1.json.

incidents.title: OF Class ID Error in ops01_corrective_audit_ledger_v1.json Claim 11

drift_details.c1_value: Materialized label masks positive for OF (Class 8)
drift_details.canonical_value: Materialized label masks positive for OF (Class 6)

incidents.resolution: ops01_corrective_audit_ledger_v2.json corrects both fields. Ledger_v1 is superseded by ledger_v2.
incidents.regression_test_description: Add test to verify ledger OF claim references source_label_id=6 not Class 8.

incidents.title: Geographic Basin Sub-label Inconsistency Between C1 Report Table and manifest_v3
incidents.scope: Narrative description of Indian Ocean basin sub-label only

drift_details.basin_label_in_c1_table: Indian Ocean / Andaman Sea / Bay of Bengal
drift_details.basin_label_in_manifest_v3: Indian Ocean / Arabian Sea / Bay of Bengal
drift_details.note: Both refer to the same 5 parent scenes. Manifest_v3 is authoritative.

incidents.resolution: manifest_v3 ocean_basin field is authoritative. C2 geographic audit document ops01_geographic_basin_audit_v1.json uses manifest_v3 labels.
